Later, we gathered in the classroom

We decided that Scott was right, so we
created posters explaining each ingredient's origins, popularity, and health

We also prepared small samples so people could taste them before
buying.
The next day, things changed.
With free samples and clearer explanations,
people stopped, tried the food, and became curious. We were busy answering
questions and serving customers returning to buy more.
